sql_problem.title: Particle-number-uniform modified logarithmic Sobolev bounds for strictly separating generalized random transpositions
sql_problem.difficulty_reason: Supplying the classical random transposition base case (Lemma 4.2, imported by the authors from Gao--Quastel and Goel) and the weighted Shearer inequality, the source-local mechanism is the analysis of noncommuting partial permutation entropy projections P_A: commutation is restored through a shared projection, a two-sided comparison of the permutation entropy phi(A) with mu[Ent_A(f)] is proved, and the comparison is combined with the GRT Dirichlet form and tensorization to give constants uniform in the particle number N. The counted proof closes all three cases, namely general strictly separating nu, one-point crossover, and uniform crossover including symmetric functions, with explicit constants depending only on nu and n. This coupled-permutation modified logarithmic Sobolev inequality with N-uniform constants is beyond ordinary qualification probability.
